must_identify.item: The api Service has no endpoints
must_identify.evidence: Error: Service has no endpoints, expected label app=api-v2

must_identify.item: Its selector (app=api-v2) does not match the pod labels (app=api)
must_identify.evidence: The Service cannot find any Pods because no Pods have the required label "app=api-v2".

notes: The RCA treats app=api-v2 as the correct label and never says the pods carry app=api or that the selector changed. Its fix relabels the pods or the Deployment instead of restoring the selector to app=api. It also adds an unrelated redis ClusterIP repair issue, and its delete-and-recreate advice for that Service is a risky distraction.
